name: Matthew A. Morris
description: SPC Morris was killed by an improvised explosive device while on patrol in Baghdad, Iraq. He was assigned to Fort Hood. A memorial statue in his likeness stands in Cedar Park Veterans Memorial Park.

name: Jeremy O. Allmon
description: SPC Allmon was killed by enemy small arms fire during combat operations in Taji, Iraq. He was stationed at Fort Hood, Texas.

name: Jacob H. Allcott
description: PFC Allcott was killed by an IED while conducting mounted patrol operations in Baghdad, Iraq. He was assigned to Fort Hood.

name: Leslie D. Jackson
unit: 64th Military Police Company, 720th MP Battalion, 89th MP Brigade
description: PFC Jackson was the youngest female soldier killed in Iraq when she died from injuries sustained during a vehicle rollover. She was stationed at Fort Hood.

name: Alexis V. Maldonado
unit: 510th Clearance Company, 20th Engineer Battalion, 36th Engineer Brigade
description: PFC Maldonado died at Kandahar Air Field, Afghanistan, from wounds sustained when insurgents attacked his unit with an improvised explosive device. He was stationed at Fort Hood.

name: James G. Johnston
description: SGT Johnston was killed during combat operations in Uruzgan Province, Afghanistan. An explosive ordnance disposal technician, he was assigned to Fort Hood, Texas.

name: Brandon S. Tobler
description: SPC Tobler was killed when his convoy struck an improvised explosive device in Baghdad, Iraq. He was stationed at Fort Hood.

name: Tomas Garces
description: SSG Garces was killed by an improvised explosive device while on combat patrol in Baghdad, Iraq. A native of Austin, he enlisted shortly after graduating from high school.

name: Michael A. Marzano
description: CPL Marzano was killed in action in Helmand Province, Afghanistan, while supporting combat operations. He had deep ties to the Central Texas community.

name: Chad S. Drake
unit: 4th Squadron, 9th Cavalry Regiment, 2nd Brigade, 1st Cavalry Division
description: SPC Drake was killed in action during combat operations in Baghdad, Iraq. Born and raised in Austin, he was remembered for his dedication to his fellow soldiers and country.

name: Robert A. Swaney
description: SSG Swaney was killed by an IED during a dismounted patrol in Mosul, Iraq. He grew up in Austin and was known for his quiet leadership.

name: Richard A. Perez Jr.
description: SPC Perez was killed during the Second Battle of Fallujah. A lifelong Austin resident, he joined the Army at 17 with parental consent.
